facts.fact: From 1 May 2026 users of the Import and Export permit online service must sign in with SeyID, the national digital identity, and businesses must also register the entity on the Biz Auth portal, per the Trade Division press conference.

SYC.note: Document says nothing on civil register and ID links.
Document names no strategy document, only a broader digital transformation strategy in passing with no standing, text or period.

facts.fact: Seychelles modernised government services through the monServis portal in 2024, and the Import and Export permit online service migrates to it from the E-Services Gateway on 1 May 2026, per the Trade Division and DICT.

SYC.note: No enrolment count or share given.
Nothing on an ID number at birth.
Nothing on who operates, maintains or owns SeyID.
No public register keyed on the ID number is stated; Biz Auth entity registration is a login step, not a register.

facts.fact: The document states SeyID is the national digital identity launched in 2022 and now required to access the IE-Permit service.

SYC.note: DICT staff presented the migration but the document does not say who built or runs the systems.
